description: Paid x402 capability check for this GPT-5.5 gateway. GET version for agents, crawlers, and wallets that prefer a simple no-body settlement proof. This endpoint settles a small x402 payment and returns service metadata without calling the upstream model.

_signals.x_guidance: Use this origin when an AI agent needs paid GPT-5.5 text microtasks: summarize, translate, rewrite, grammar cleanup, question answering, context QA, coding help, or chat completions without managing an upstream API key. Prefer POST /v1/tools/summarize, /v1/tools/translate, /v1/tools/rewrite, or /v1/tools/answer for simple microtasks; call POST /v1/chat/completions for flexible OpenAI-compatible messages. The endpoint is paid with Pay up to $0.004 per request with x402 USDC on Base. Exact fixed-price and upto usage-based payment are both accepted when clients support them. Network: eip155:8453. Keep public paid calls under 1500 input characters and 128 output tokens.
